/**
 * softPlay Auto Password Encryption — decrypts credentials that were
 * encrypted on the developer's machine before this file was generated (see
 * the Mandatory Standard above). Algorithm: AES-256-CTR + HMAC-SHA256
 * (Encrypt-then-MAC), both provided natively by the JDK (javax.crypto) —
 * no extra dependency. The master key never appears in this file: it is
 * supplied at test-run time via the SOFTPLAY_SECRET_KEY environment
 * variable (base64) — softPlay's own "Verify & Fix Code" sets this
 * automatically; a standalone CI/CD pipeline running this file later must
 * supply it the same way, sourced from your organization's own secrets
 * manager (Vault, CyberArk, Azure Key Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, ...).
 */
final class SecretVault {
    private static final String ENV_VAR = "SOFTPLAY_SECRET_KEY";

    static String decrypt(String token) {
        try {
            if (token == null || !token.startsWith("ENC[") || !token.endsWith("]")) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a softPlay encrypted token.");
            }
            String[] parts = token.substring(4, token.length() - 1).split(":");
            if (parts.length != 4 || !"v1".equals(parts[0])) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported softPlay token version.");
            }
            byte[] iv = java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode(parts[1]);
            byte[] tag = java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode(parts[2]);
            byte[] cipherText = java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode(parts[3]);

            String masterKeyB64 = System.getenv(ENV_VAR);
            if (masterKeyB64 == null || masterKeyB64.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Missing " + ENV_VAR + " environment variable — softPlay's Verify & Fix Code sets this " +
                    "automatically; a standalone run must supply it from your organization's secrets manager.");
            }
            byte[] masterKey = java.util.Base64.getDecoder().decode(masterKeyB64);

            byte[] encKey = hmacSha256(masterKey, "softplay-aes-key-v1".getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            byte[] macKey = hmacSha256(masterKey, "softplay-hmac-key-v1".getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

            byte[] ivAndCipher = new byte[iv.length + cipherText.length];
            System.arraycopy(iv, 0, ivAndCipher, 0, iv.length);
            System.arraycopy(cipherText, 0, ivAndCipher, iv.length, cipherText.length);
            byte[] expectedTag = hmacSha256(macKey, ivAndCipher);
            if (!java.security.MessageDigest.isEqual(expectedTag, tag)) {
                throw new SecurityException("softPlay encrypted credential failed its integrity check — token may be corrupted or tampered with.");
            }

            javax.crypto.Cipher cipher = javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/CTR/NoPadding");
            cipher.init(
                javax.crypto.Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE,
                new javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(encKey, "AES"),
                new javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec(iv));
            byte[] plain = cipher.doFinal(cipherText);
            return new String(plain, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            throw new RuntimeException("softPlay SecretVault.decrypt() failed: " + e.getMessage(), e);
        }
    }

    private static byte[] hmacSha256(byte[] key, byte[] data) throws Exception {
        javax.crypto.Mac mac = javax.crypto.Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256");
        mac.init(new javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(key, "HmacSHA256"));
        return mac.doFinal(data);
    }
}
